errors.evidence: The legend in the chart shows the orange bar represents "介动紧密度", but the description incorrectly adds an extra character, making it "介动紧密密度".
The y-axis categories are arranged from Top1000 at the top to Top100 at the bottom, which is the reverse of what is stated in the description.
The value for the shortest blue bar, corresponding to the 'Top100' category, is approximately 45, not 35.
The value for the longest orange bar, corresponding to the 'Top1000' category, is approximately 25, not 30.
The description claims there is no obvious sorting, but the y-axis categories are clearly sorted in descending order from Top1000 to Top100.
